description: Developed and deployed responsive web interfaces using React.js and Tailwind CSS, improving page usability and UI consistency across 5+ client-facing modules.
Built and optimized SaaS spend analytics dashboards using Node.js and Express, reducing manual processing effort by 40–50% and accelerating reporting workflows.

Developed Python web scraping scripts to collect and organize data for keyword search functionality.
Created responsive Shopify storefront components using JavaScript and Liquid.
